test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 01 Dec, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2cb78f7b60886b8793569c616ce1e97212fcee87f94e768534b4aafd4fd73fb.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

All the elements shift anticlockwise subsequently.

The first element from the left is replaced by the new element.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10207e7b07227b6dab2a5027b654f120570e015349b10895eadf1fbb7b7f0122.png] 

2) Second box series →

The first three elements from the left shift anticlockwise subsequently.

The last two elements from the left shift anticlockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83944504bb6971a4bfa6a9003eb455d91cfc49c9c3a7c76d4c1ed596d35dcd7c.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fc674f476bf88a2c5c35b24f7ce48a087a224219682fcc4d5e68bdada0f3551.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
